Hero_Desc_AmeliaR41:
Amelia came here from Dimension R41 after many twists and turns.
No longer a ruthless ruler, she is quickly adapting to this new dimension as an elf in her own right.
At times, her astonishing self-admiration leaves the Apostles around her at a loss.
Album_Like_AmeliaR41: Myself, the greatest elf in the world; inventions
Album_AmeliaR411: Amelia says she sometimes feels flustered when the many Apostles on the street strike up friendly conversations with her. She says such a thing would have been unimaginable in Dimension R41... It seems it must have been an exceptionally bleak place.
Album_AmeliaR412: Amelia spent quite some time gazing intently into a mirror, completely unaware that I had approached. When she finally noticed me, she jumped and looked embarrassed. I cannot even guess how entranced she had been by her own reflection.
Album_AmeliaR413: After taking an interest in Orr's inventions at the Order, Amelia asked me to introduce her to Orr. The two later met in Monatium and reportedly had a wonderful time excitedly discussing each other's inventions. Unlike Secretary Amelia, this Amelia seems to like Orr.
Album_AmeliaR414: Amelia asked me to hire someone to run coffee errands for her, and I told her that would be difficult. After a moment's thought, Amelia crossed her legs with an imperious air and magnanimously announced that she would employ me as her coffee runner instead. Too flustered to answer properly, I mumbled something and practically fled.
Album_AmeliaR415: Amelia has taken up a new hobby lately: debating Secretary Amelia. They usually end in draws, but she says nothing feels quite as satisfying as successfully leaving Secretary Amelia at a loss for words. A debate between two Amelias... The scene was so easy to imagine that it sent a chill down my spine.
Album_AmeliaR416: Amelia sometimes goes for walks in Monatium. So much of the old imperial city has been preserved that she says it feels like traveling through time. Her expression looked terribly wistful when she said it.
Album_AmeliaR417: When something weighs on her or she has a problem, Amelia sometimes comes to me for advice. At first she seemed uncomfortable and reluctant to reveal her weaknesses, but now she looks much more accustomed to it and at ease. I am glad Amelia has found someone she can rely on here.
LoveHero_AmeliaR41: You wish to spend time with me? Very well. I shall make a special exception for you.
LoveHeroCancel_AmeliaR41: You will come to realize in the most painful terms that no being is more perfect than I.
Food_ChefNote_AmeliaR41_Hate1: She shuddered, calling it the most horrifying-looking thing she had seen since crossing into this dimension. I still cannot forget the contempt on her face...
Food_ChefNote_AmeliaR41_Hate2: After taking one bite of the space rations, Amelia suddenly began rattling off improvements at incredible speed. Then she sharply ordered me to bring her something else.
Food_ChefNote_AmeliaR41_Like1: She praised it as a perfect food that pairs harmoniously with any dish. Apparently she cannot understand why this dimension's Amelia dislikes rice.
Food_ChefNote_AmeliaR41_Like2: She was delighted, saying it tasted remarkably like the chocolate ice cream she used to enjoy in Dimension R41. Perhaps it is a food tied to memories of someone?
Food_ChefNote_AmeliaR41_Like3: As she ate the rice cakes, she said they tasted somewhat like rice and took a liking to them.
Food_ChefNote_AmeliaR41_Like4: She said it was a flavor she would think of every day and tried to recruit me as her personal pastry chef. She looked disappointed when I politely declined.
Food_ChefNote_AmeliaR41_Like5: She praised it as the perfect snack for an all-night research session. Apparently it jolts her wide awake.
Food_ChefNote_AmeliaR41_Like6: When I explained that songpyeon was a food from my homeland, Amelia silently savored it, then gave me a faint smile. What did that smile mean?
Food_ChefNote_AmeliaR41_Like7: Amelia declared Almond Pralines to have the perfect level of sweetness for her perfect self. That may be the highest praise Amelia is capable of giving.
Food_ChefNote_AmeliaR41_Like8: She said it was not merely sour but had a range of flavors. It must have suited her tastes, because she packed several YumYumVitC to take with her.
Food_ChefNote_AmeliaR41_Like9: After staring at the candy for quite some time, Amelia said it resembled the way the many races of this dimension live in harmony.
Gacha_Result_SpecialLine1_AmeliaR41: I have crossed the crossroads of dimensions.
Gacha_Result_Line1_AmeliaR41: Even if this is the place I fled to, I will fulfill my duty.
AmeliaR41_Growth: This body is Amelia, Mayor of the Monatium Empire.
AmeliaR41_Growth1: Does this body's growth not frighten you?
AmeliaR41_Growth2: This is a common occurrence. There is no need for surprise.
AmeliaR41_Victory1: This body is the symbol of victory.
AmeliaR41_Victory2: It is merely the natural outcome.
AmeliaR41_Defeat1: Oh dear. Was I too careless...?
AmeliaR41_Affinity1_1: Hmm. As expected, I am perfect again today. Even more so than yesterday.
AmeliaR41_Affinity1_2: To this body, research and invention are as natural as breathing.
AmeliaR41_Affinity2: Ah... Is there nobody willing to attend upon this body?
AmeliaR41_Affinity1_3: I ceaselessly refine myself, develop, and advance. I will never tolerate stagnation.
AmeliaR41_Affinity3: Which do you think is more beautiful, Amelia or this body? Answer me at once.
AmeliaR41_Affinity4: Having always lived beneath gazes of awe, life here forever feels new to me.
AmeliaR41_Affinity5: I still keep a journal every day. You appear in it as well, Master. Its contents are secret, so do not ask.
AmeliaR41_Affinity6: This body is confident of excelling at anything, so you may rely upon me.
AmeliaR41_Affinity7: Master, I shall specially acknowledge you as this body's companion. Consider it an honor.
AmeliaR41_LevelUp: I have become even more perfect.
AmeliaR41_Equipment: Yes, this is the minimum I expect.
AmeliaR41_HeroSkill: Once again I have reached the pinnacle of technology.
AmeliaR41_Board: I shall arrive soon, so wait quietly.
AmeliaR41_DeckSetting1: Consider it an honor to accompany me.
AmeliaR41_Stage: Trust me and advance with confidence!
AmeliaR41_Touch1: How dare you touch my royal person! Insolent!
AmeliaR41_Touch1_1: I-I shall punish you without fail!
AmeliaR41_Touch2_1: Ahem. I am aware of my own beauty.
AmeliaR41_Touch1_2: I once ruled an empire, despite appearances...
AmeliaR41_Touch2: D-do not treat me like a child.
AmeliaR41_Touch2_2: It feels as though my existence is being acknowledged. Not unpleasant.
AmeliaR41_DutchRubEnd2: Do I appear so ridiculous to you?!
Item_HeroSkin_Desc_AmeliaR41_Skin1: At Taida's suggestion, Amelia (R41) appeared dressed as the elven protagonist of a popular darknet novel. She keeps checking herself in the mirror, saying she looks even more regal and elegant.
AmeliaR41_Growth1_Skin1: It seems I am destined to resonate with this world.
AmeliaR41_Growth2_Skin1: Do not dare compare me with others.
AmeliaR41_LevelUp_Skin1: I shall use this power for what is right.
AmeliaR41_HeroSkill_Skin1: The course of the future just changed.
AmeliaR41_Board_Skin1: I need only patrol that place?
AmeliaR41_Touch1_Skin1: If you have a complaint, voice it.
AmeliaR41_Touch1_1_Skin1: I cannot comprehend this at all.
AmeliaR41_Touch1_2_Skin1: Treasure me as you treasure nature.
AmeliaR41_Touch2_Skin1: Is my hair truly so soft?
AmeliaR41_Touch2_2_Skin1: A fleeting moment that feels like eternity.
Aside_Get_AmeliaR411: This feeling that pierces me from time to time... Is it lingering attachment, or longing?
Aside_Upgrade_AmeliaR411: I shall never repeat the same failure again. So watch me.
AmeliaR41_AsideGet: This feeling that pierces me from time to time... Is it lingering attachment, or longing?
AmeliaR41_AsideUpgrade: I shall never repeat the same failure again. So watch me.
AmeliaR41_Birthday: Today is your birthday, Master. Tell me if you desire anything. I shall gladly grant it, whatever it may be.
AmeliaR41_Gacha2: Even in the place to which I fled, I shall fulfill my duty.
AmeliaR41_Gacha3: I have crossed the crossroads of dimensions.
AmeliaR41_Line1: I am Mayor Amelia, the perfected Elf who shall bring chaos to the world.
AmeliaR41_Line2: Looking into a mirror is always thrilling and delightful.
AmeliaR41_Line3: No one shall dare surpass me.
AmeliaR41_Lobby: Hmm. As expected, I am perfect today as well.
LoveLetter_AmeliaR41:
Master, a considerable amount of time has passed since I first began relying on you.

Although I have made mistakes, as one who once ruled a world, I feel a certain kinship with you. I am still learning much from you: how to become a righteous leader, how to govern in a way that inspires genuine devotion... things of that nature. I hope that someday I may become... someone you need not be ashamed of.

In the hope that one day... I may sit beside you and guide Elias toward a new path.

-Amelia von Monatium
LoveCall_AmeliaR41:
Master, what are you doing right now?
Ah, it is nothing in particular... I was simply wandering around when you came to mind.

That I, having been cast into an entirely unfamiliar dimension, have adapted so well is partly thanks to my exceptional adaptability... but I believe much of the credit belongs to you, Master.
I do not often put it into words, but are there not some feelings that can be understood without being spoken?

Still, since I have already called you, today I shall make a special exception and offer you my thanks.
Master, thank you for always being so considerate of me... truly.

If there is ever anything I can do to help, call me at any time. Even if there is no particular reason, I would gladly let you hear my voice, Master.
After all, you are worthy of taking up my precious time.
Ahem. I shall hang up now. We will meet again later.
Affinity_AmeliaR41_EP01_001: This world... differs greatly from my dimension.
Affinity_AmeliaR41_EP01_002: Do you regret it a little?
Affinity_AmeliaR41_EP01_003: I do not regret my decision. Whatever happened, I chose the optimal course through meticulous calculation. But if there is anything I truly regret...
Affinity_AmeliaR41_EP01_005: Sometimes, what seems obvious is not obvious at all. Take care.
Affinity_AmeliaR41_EP01_006: It is an interesting place, is it not?
Affinity_AmeliaR41_EP01_007: Well, I thought it would be nothing special... but honestly, it is rather entertaining. There are quite a few intriguing things here.
Affinity_AmeliaR41_EP02_001: Elena remains mayor... I have a feeling incidents will be frequent.
Affinity_AmeliaR41_EP02_003: ...That does not surprise me. Was it not the expected outcome? But how did she become mayor again?
Affinity_AmeliaR41_EP02_006: Amelia supports her well, so everything is fine.
Affinity_AmeliaR41_EP02_007: As expected of me. Any Amelia capable of dragging that Elena along and keeping Monatium running must be an extraordinary being.
Affinity_AmeliaR41_EP03_001: Master, serve me food whose nutritional balance has been utterly shattered and destroyed.
Affinity_AmeliaR41_EP03_002: I will give you grilled meat piled high with triple cheese.
Affinity_AmeliaR41_EP03_003: Excellent. To think you would serve something so perfectly suited to my tastes. You may become my personal chef.
Affinity_AmeliaR41_EP03_004: Would you like a marshmallow macaron?
Affinity_AmeliaR41_EP03_005: Its nutrition is certainly unbalanced, but I refuse food that is merely sweet. A single dominant flavor does not suit my palate. Bring me something more varied.
Affinity_AmeliaR41_EP03_006: Be a proper Elf and eat space rations.
Affinity_AmeliaR41_EP03_007: Leave that trash to lesser beings. Space rations are the worst invention ever created!
Affinity_AmeliaR41_EP04_002: Give me one if you create a good invention.
Affinity_AmeliaR41_EP04_003: You desire one of my inventions? Then serve a dish capable of satisfying me. I may bestow one upon you.
Affinity_AmeliaR41_EP04_004: If you make ten, what percentage succeeds?
Affinity_AmeliaR41_EP04_005: ...You appear to have confused me with the Amelia of this world. My success rate is one hundred percent.
Affinity_AmeliaR41_EP04_006: It is good to have a hobby.
Affinity_AmeliaR41_EP04_007: A hobby? Invention is me, and I am invention. Do not reduce it to a mere pastime. Remember that well.
Affinity_AmeliaR41_EP05_001: I ordered food at a Monatium cafe, only to receive bitter coffee and dishes of monotonous flavor.
Affinity_AmeliaR41_EP05_002: That is because Amelia drinks only bitter coffee.
Affinity_AmeliaR41_EP05_003: The Amelia of this dimension has a poor palate. I shall teach her the meaning of true flavor next time.
Affinity_AmeliaR41_EP05_004: Here is chocolate ice cream for you.
Affinity_AmeliaR41_EP05_005: Hmm... Good. This earns a passing grade. Sweetness that strikes the mind the instant it enters one's mouth... Satisfying.
Affinity_AmeliaR41_EP05_006: Perhaps you confused me with another Amelia.
Affinity_AmeliaR41_EP05_007: Should I create a guide for visitors from other dimensions? Is that Amelia doing her work properly? I shall have to teach her a lesson.
Affinity_AmeliaR41_EP06_001: What kind of person... is the Elena here?
Affinity_AmeliaR41_EP06_002: What do you think of her?
Affinity_AmeliaR41_EP06_003: ...She resembles the Elena of my dimension in some ways, yet differs greatly. Master, could that be your influence?
Affinity_AmeliaR41_EP06_004: She is someone Amelia would like.
Affinity_AmeliaR41_EP06_005: ...I see. What? Why are you staring at me like that? I asked only from curiosity. Someone Amelia would like... I see.
Affinity_AmeliaR41_EP06_007: Why would the Amelia of this dimension choose someone like that...? Hmph... Pathetic.
Affinity_AmeliaR41_EP07_001: A ghost came, played a prank, and left. ...Insolent creature.
Affinity_AmeliaR41_EP07_002: As the superior being, endure it.
Affinity_AmeliaR41_EP07_003: Very well. As a superior being, I shall tolerate it. But tell them there will be no mercy if they misbehave once more.
Affinity_AmeliaR41_EP07_005: Is it not natural to like me? I am Amelia, the greatest Elf and the greatest ruler.
Affinity_AmeliaR41_EP07_006: Could it be because you look easy to torment?
Affinity_AmeliaR41_EP07_007: Easy to... Me? This magnificent being? It must have confused me with this world's Amelia. Anyone who truly knew me could never think so.
Affinity_AmeliaR41_EP08_001: Master, you are far too lenient.
Affinity_AmeliaR41_EP08_003: Someone offers sincere advice, and you respond by attacking them. That is the mark of a bad ruler.
Affinity_AmeliaR41_EP08_005: You are too lenient with those in the Order. It would be wise to enforce discipline from time to time.
Affinity_AmeliaR41_EP08_007: Hmm... Gentleness is true strength... That does not appear entirely wrong.
Affinity_AmeliaR41_EP09_001: Some things remain unchanged even when the dimension changes.
Affinity_AmeliaR41_EP09_003: ...N-Ngh... Do not mention those days! Never mention them!
Affinity_AmeliaR41_EP09_005: ...Hmm, perhaps. Devotion... Yes. I once possessed feelings like that too.
Affinity_AmeliaR41_EP09_006: A turning point in an important incident?
Affinity_AmeliaR41_EP09_007: Something like that. You are more intelligent than I expected, Master.
Affinity_AmeliaR41_EP10_001: Do I find anything inconvenient? Naturally, many things. For example...
Affinity_AmeliaR41_EP10_003: Whom are you treating like a difficult customer? Were you not the one who asked? Truly unbelievable.
Affinity_AmeliaR41_EP10_004: The banquet hall does not accept complaints.
Affinity_AmeliaR41_EP10_005: Then why did you ask? I cannot understand. Do you enjoy inefficiency? That is even more incomprehensible.
Affinity_AmeliaR41_EP10_006: Scientific development differs here, so it cannot be helped.
Affinity_AmeliaR41_EP10_007: That is true. It is only mildly inconvenient, not severe. In my superiority, I shall generously overlook it.
Affinity_AmeliaR41_EP11_001: I met the leaders of this dimension...
Affinity_AmeliaR41_EP11_003: Not bad. They seemed free of prejudice toward beings from other dimensions... Hmm. Perhaps they were not merely 'not bad,' but genuinely good.
Affinity_AmeliaR41_EP11_005: Hmm... I could not identify much difference between them and those of my own dimension.
Affinity_AmeliaR41_EP11_007: Do you think I am an Elf who does nothing but fight? I have no intention of fighting here.
Affinity_AmeliaR41_EP12_001: Is there somewhere I can go for a change of pace?
Affinity_AmeliaR41_EP12_002: Did the Order make you uncomfortable?
Affinity_AmeliaR41_EP12_003: That is not what I meant. Remaining only at the Order has become stifling. I merely want to walk and clear my mind.
Affinity_AmeliaR41_EP12_005: Watching a film is a fine way to relax, but... Renewa is there. That would be somewhat uncomfortable.
Affinity_AmeliaR41_EP12_007: I do enjoy sweets, but I prefer more varied flavors. Something with a touch of salt, for example.
Affinity_AmeliaR41_EP13_001: The Elementals are more... than I expected.
Affinity_AmeliaR41_EP13_003: Hmm... There was a ball of flame who suddenly swung a sword. I nearly attacked without thinking. Someone should warn her.
Affinity_AmeliaR41_EP13_005: Elemental Lake? Why? Is there a water ghost? That Naia seemed rather agreeable... She was well mannered.
Affinity_AmeliaR41_EP13_006: She is good, is she not?
Affinity_AmeliaR41_EP13_007: Yes. They were extremely hostile in our dimension... What a surprise. I visited Elemental Mountain and received an abundance of gifts.
Affinity_AmeliaR41_EP14_001: Is it acceptable for someone as magnificent and exceptional as me to exist in this dimension? Might I disrupt its balance?
Affinity_AmeliaR41_EP14_003: ...That is reassuring, yet why am I offended? Was it because you answered so firmly, or because you imply I am not exceptional at all? Which is it?
Affinity_AmeliaR41_EP14_004: If there were a problem, you would have noticed first.
Affinity_AmeliaR41_EP14_005: You are correct. Naturally, I would have noticed first. My abilities are so exceptional that they force me to worry about matters like this... What a predicament.
Affinity_AmeliaR41_EP14_006: Renewa provides a precedent, so it should be fine.
Affinity_AmeliaR41_EP14_007: Hmm, true. The Renewa here was not born in this dimension. Good. With a precedent, there can be no problem.
Affinity_AmeliaR41_EP15_001: ...What? Why are you looking at me like that?
Affinity_AmeliaR41_EP15_003: ...Well, perhaps resting without thought lets me focus upon research. Setting administrative work aside after so long has been rather comfortable.
Affinity_AmeliaR41_EP15_005: Hmm? This is my personal secretary, one might say... a drone that handles assorted menial tasks. Are you interested?
Affinity_AmeliaR41_EP15_006: Am I not allowed to look?
Affinity_AmeliaR41_EP15_007: Why stare at an Elf when you have no reason to? You appear to have something to say, so speak clearly. I shall specially grant you an audience.
Affinity_AmeliaR41_EP16_001: I visited the Order this morning and held a deep discussion with the High Priest.
Affinity_AmeliaR41_EP16_003: You have managed the Order's work reasonably well, but there seem to be deficiencies. We discussed operational efficiency.
Affinity_AmeliaR41_EP16_004: I heard you agreed to help me. Thank you.
Affinity_AmeliaR41_EP16_005: ...Rather than helping, I agreed to advise you on administration. You are not such a terrible ruler.
Affinity_AmeliaR41_EP16_007: I now understand exactly what you think of me. First, I must teach you that I am no scoundrel who starts fights without reason. Sit down here.
Affinity_AmeliaR41_EP17_001: ...I am sleepy. My shoulders feel somewhat stiff.
Affinity_AmeliaR41_EP17_003: Hmm... Working up a sweat and then visiting the hot springs would be ideal... Not a bad solution.
Affinity_AmeliaR41_EP17_004: How about warm tea and soup?
Affinity_AmeliaR41_EP17_005: Hmm... A reasonable suggestion. A nap would be perfect right now... but I shall finish my work before considering it.
Affinity_AmeliaR41_EP17_006: Eating and immediately sleeping causes indigestion, so endure it for now.
Affinity_AmeliaR41_EP17_007: Master, you... Do you imagine I asked because I did not know the solution myself? Sigh...
Affinity_AmeliaR41_EP18_001: Is there nothing you wish to ask me? I am in a fair mood today, so I shall listen first and then decide whether to answer.
Affinity_AmeliaR41_EP18_002: Do you not miss your Elena?
Affinity_AmeliaR41_EP18_003: I-I do... But that too is my fault, a burden I must carry. I shall... continue moving forward.
Affinity_AmeliaR41_EP18_004: Do you not miss your dimension?
Affinity_AmeliaR41_EP18_005: It would be a lie to say I do not. Sometimes, I miss it. But... I cannot return now, so I endure.
Affinity_AmeliaR41_EP18_007: Why state something so obvious? There is no success without failure. What? Do my inventions fail too? How absurd... I refuse to answer.
Affinity_AmeliaR41_EP19_001: You ask what I thought of Monatium?
Affinity_AmeliaR41_EP19_002: It is a lively, wonderful place, is it not?
Affinity_AmeliaR41_EP19_003: Hmm... Everyone wore smiles. This is a good place.
Affinity_AmeliaR41_EP19_004: This dimension's Amelia is capable too.
Affinity_AmeliaR41_EP19_005: Yes... Though it would be better if she spent less time sacrificing sleep for fan clubs and the like. Still, that is for her to decide.
Affinity_AmeliaR41_EP19_006: It has good relations with other cities, right?
Affinity_AmeliaR41_EP19_007: Coexistence rather than domination... It is not a bad policy. ...That does not mean I failed.
Affinity_AmeliaR41_EP20_001: This invention should be useful for cooking. ...I did not create it especially for you. The idea simply occurred to me.
Affinity_AmeliaR41_EP20_002: Cooking tastes best when done personally.
Affinity_AmeliaR41_EP20_003: You do not even know how to appreciate someone's consideration... Tch. Hand it over so I can take it back. What? You apologize? Ridiculous.
Affinity_AmeliaR41_EP20_005: Watching you struggle alone with everything made me think you needed it. If you are grateful... perhaps serve me another dish.
Affinity_AmeliaR41_EP20_007: Tch. Inspect it and understand the structure. Press that button. Use it with gratitude for my invention.
